description: Inquisition canonical thresholds. Non-overridable items per charter invariants I7, I8, I9.

secrets_entropy_code.description: Entropy floor (bits/char) for generic detector in code/JSON/config files

secrets_entropy_text.description: Entropy floor (bits/char) for generic detector in text/markdown files

pi_score_block_llm.description: PI cumulative weight to trigger BLOCK for LLM authors (Q4 adaptive)

pi_score_block_owner.description: PI cumulative weight to trigger BLOCK for OWNER_MANUAL (Q4 adaptive)

trust_baseline_llm.description: Starting trust score for new LLM authors (Q5 neutral)

trust_delta_ok.description: Trust gain per CYCLE_OK; x1.5 multiplier applies after 5 consecutive OKs (Q6 streak bonus)

trust_min_permit.description: Minimum trust to PERMIT; below = BLOCK_TRUST (Q7 strict)

probation_cycles.description: First N cycles of new LLM author: BLOCK_TRUST replaced by HINT_PROBATION (Q13 deliquentry mode)

ban_burst_consec.description: Consecutive BLOCKs (no OK in between) to trigger autoban (Q8 default)

ban_burst_weekly.description: BLOCKs within 7-day rolling window to trigger autoban (Q8 safety net)

ban_duration.description: Ban remains in effect until OWNER_MANUAL submits explicit unban pack (Q9)

purge_requires_core_ready.description: PURGE_PROTOCOL DORMANT until core_ready=true is landed in Administratum registry (charter I9)

fail_closed_default.description: Any subprocess error/timeout = FAIL_CLOSED; never silent-pass (charter I4)

anomaly_first_author.description: First pack from any author always triggers HINT_FIRST_AUTHOR (non-overridable)

performance_budget_small_pack_sec.description: Total PRE-ADMIT Inq budget for packs with ≤10 payload files (Q33 adaptive)

performance_budget_large_pack_sec.description: Total PRE-ADMIT Inq budget for packs with >10 payload files (Q33 adaptive)

timeout_lint_like_sec.description: Per-tool timeout for fast lint-like tools (Q17)

timeout_audit_sec.description: Per-tool timeout for trace/audit tools that may walk full history (Q17)
